name: bite-and-brew
description: Bite & Brew — Café & Hangout management platform (POS, inventory, printing, finance)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @bitebrew/server && npm run build -w @bitebrew/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck -w @bitebrew/server && npm run typecheck -w @bitebrew/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test -w @bitebrew/shared && npm run test -w @bitebrew/server
